content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository pulp-platform_axi_pr185, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# axi_dw_up/downsizer: Latch inference when synthesizing with Mentor Precision
When synthesizing with _Mentor Precision_, the tool infers latches in the `axi_dw_upsizer` and `axi_dw_downsizer`.
Seems the tool has an issue with the automatic variable `r_data` and `w_data` in both modules.
Links to the of the offending codelines of `axi_dw_upsizer` and `axi_dw_downsizer`:
https://github.com/pulp-platform/axi/blob/f847575bab7269f88f6caa36f01275de2007378a/src/axi_dw_upsizer.sv#L478-L492
https://github.com/pulp-platform/axi/blob/f847575bab7269f88f6caa36f01275de2007378a/src/axi_dw_upsizer.sv#L595-L607
https://github.com/pulp-platform/axi/blob/f847575bab7269f88f6caa36f01275de2007378a/src/axi_dw_downsizer.sv#L550-L562
https://github.com/pulp-platform/axi/blob/f847575bab7269f88f6caa36f01275de2007378a/src/axi_dw_downsizer.sv#L722-L737
At least in `axi_dw_upsizer` the assignment of `r_data` should still be the default `'0`. So `r_data` is only _saving_ the initialization value, which is then conditionally overwritten.
Then however when synthesizing with _SYNOPSYS_ the latches are not there.
When adding an `else` statement to the `if` then the latch goes away at least in the first code snippet. So an idea for a fix from my side is to add the `else` condition and remove the automatic variable.

Here is the project file that may be relevant to this issue:

212     .w_chan_t   (mst_w_chan_t  ),

228     .slv_aw_select_i(mst_req_aw_err             ),
229     .slv_req_i      (mst_req                    ),
230     .slv_resp_o     (mst_resp                   )
231   );
232 
233   /**********
234    *  READ  *
235    **********/
236 
237   typedef enum logic [1:0] {
238     R_IDLE       ,
239     R_INJECT_AW  ,
240     R_PASSTHROUGH,
241     R_INCR_UPSIZE
242   } r_state_e;
243 
244   // Write-related type, but w_req_q is referenced from Read logic
245   typedef struct packed {
246     aw_chan_t aw                ;
247     logic aw_valid              ;
248     logic aw_throw_error        ;
249     mst_w_chan_t w              ;
250     logic w_valid               ;
251     axi_pkg::len_t burst_len    ;
252     axi_pkg::size_t orig_aw_size;
253   } w_req_t;
254 
255   w_req_t   w_req_d, w_req_q;
256 
257   // Decide which upsizer will handle the incoming AXI transaction
258   logic     [AxiMaxReads-1:0] idle_read_upsizer;
259   tran_id_t                   idx_ar_upsizer ;
260 
261   // Find an idle upsizer to handle this transaction
262   tran_id_t idx_idle_upsizer;
263   lzc #(
264     .WIDTH(AxiMaxReads)
265   ) i_idle_lzc (
266     .in_i   (idle_read_upsizer),
267     .cnt_o  (idx_idle_upsizer ),
268     .empty_o(/* Unused */     )
269   );
270 
271   // Is there already another upsizer handling a transaction with the same id
272   logic     [AxiMaxReads-1:0] id_clash_upsizer;
273   tran_id_t                   idx_id_clash_upsizer ;
274   for (genvar t = 0; t < AxiMaxReads; t++) begin: gen_id_clash
275     assign id_clash_upsizer[t] = arb_slv_ar_id == mst_ar_id[t] && !idle_read_upsizer[t];
276   end
277 
278   onehot_to_bin #(
279     .ONEHOT_WIDTH(AxiMaxReads)
280   ) i_id_clash_onehot_to_bin (
281     .onehot(id_clash_upsizer    ),
282     .bin   (idx_id_clash_upsizer)
283   );
284 
285   // Choose an idle upsizer, unless there is an id clash
286   assign idx_ar_upsizer = (|id_clash_upsizer) ? idx_id_clash_upsizer : idx_idle_upsizer;
287 
288   // This logic is used to resolve which upsizer is handling
289   // each outstanding read transaction
290 
291   logic     r_upsizer_valid;
292   tran_id_t idx_r_upsizer;
293 
294   logic [AxiMaxReads-1:0] rid_upsizer_match;
295 
296   // Is there a upsizer handling this transaction?
297   assign r_upsizer_valid = |rid_upsizer_match;
298 
299   for (genvar t = 0; t < AxiMaxReads; t++) begin: gen_rid_match
300     assign rid_upsizer_match[t] = (mst_resp.r.id == mst_ar_id[t]) && !idle_read_upsizer[t];
301   end
302 
303   onehot_to_bin #(
304     .ONEHOT_WIDTH(AxiMaxReads)
305   ) i_rid_upsizer_lzc (
306     .onehot(rid_upsizer_match),
307     .bin   (idx_r_upsizer    )
308   );
309 
310   typedef struct packed {
311     ar_chan_t ar                ;
312     logic ar_valid              ;
313     logic ar_throw_error        ;
314     axi_pkg::len_t burst_len    ;
315     axi_pkg::size_t orig_ar_size;
316   } r_req_t;
317 
318   for (genvar t = 0; unsigned'(t) < AxiMaxReads; t++) begin: gen_read_upsizer
319     r_state_e r_state_d, r_state_q;
320     r_req_t r_req_d    , r_req_q  ;
321 
322     // Are we idle?
323     assign idle_read_upsizer[t] = (r_state_q == R_IDLE) || (r_state_q == R_INJECT_AW);
324 
325     always_comb begin
326       // Maintain state
327       r_state_d = r_state_q;
328       r_req_d   = r_req_q  ;
329 
330       // AR Channel
331       mst_ar_tran[t]       = r_req_q.ar      ;
332       mst_ar_id[t]         = r_req_q.ar.id   ;
333       mst_ar_valid_tran[t] = r_req_q.ar_valid;
334 
335       // Throw an error
336       mst_req_ar_err[t] = r_req_q.ar_throw_error;
337 
338       // R Channel
339       // No latency
340       slv_r_tran[t]      = '0             ;
341       slv_r_tran[t].id   = mst_resp.r.id  ;
342       slv_r_tran[t].resp = mst_resp.r.resp;
343       slv_r_tran[t].user = mst_resp.r.user;
344 
345       arb_slv_ar_gnt_tran[t] = 1'b0;
346 
347       mst_r_ready_tran[t] = 1'b0;
348       slv_r_valid_tran[t] = 1'b0;
349 
350       // Got a grant on the AR channel
351       if (mst_ar_valid_tran[t] && mst_ar_ready_tran[t]) begin
352         r_req_d.ar_valid       = 1'b0;
353         r_req_d.ar_throw_error = 1'b0;
354       end
355 
356       case (r_state_q)
357         R_IDLE : begin
358           // Reset channels
359           r_req_d.ar = '0;
360 
361           // New read request
362           if (arb_slv_ar_req && (idx_ar_upsizer == t)) begin
363             arb_slv_ar_gnt_tran[t] = 1'b1;
364 
365             // Must inject an AW request into this upsizer
366             if (inject_aw_into_ar) begin
367               r_state_d = R_INJECT_AW;
368             end else begin
369               // Default state
370               r_state_d = R_PASSTHROUGH;
371 
372               // Save beat
373               r_req_d.ar           = slv_req_i.ar     ;
374               r_req_d.ar_valid     = 1'b1             ;
375               r_req_d.burst_len    = slv_req_i.ar.len ;
376               r_req_d.orig_ar_size = slv_req_i.ar.size;
377 
378               case (r_req_d.ar.burst)
379                 axi_pkg::BURST_INCR: begin
380                   // Modifiable transaction
381                   if (modifiable(r_req_d.ar.cache)) begin
382                     // No need to upsize single-beat transactions.
383                     if (r_req_d.ar.len != '0) begin
384                       // Evaluate output burst length
385                       automatic addr_t start_addr = aligned_addr(r_req_d.ar.addr, AxiMstPortMaxSize);
386                       automatic addr_t end_addr   = aligned_addr(beat_addr(r_req_d.ar.addr,
387                           r_req_d.orig_ar_size, r_req_d.burst_len, r_req_d.ar.burst,
388                           r_req_d.burst_len), AxiMstPortMaxSize);
389                       r_req_d.ar.len  = (end_addr - start_addr) >> AxiMstPortMaxSize;
390                       r_req_d.ar.size = AxiMstPortMaxSize                           ;
391                       r_state_d       = R_INCR_UPSIZE                               ;
392                     end
393                   end
394                 end
395 
396                 axi_pkg::BURST_FIXED: begin
397                   // Passes through the upsizer without any changes
398                   r_state_d = R_PASSTHROUGH;
399                 end
400 
401                 axi_pkg::BURST_WRAP: begin
402                   // The DW converter does not support this kind of burst ...
403                   r_state_d              = R_PASSTHROUGH;
404                   r_req_d.ar_throw_error = 1'b1         ;
405 
406                   // ... but might if this is a single-beat transaction
407                   if (r_req_d.ar.len == '0)
408                     r_req_d.ar_throw_error = 1'b0;
409                 end
410               endcase
411             end
412           end
413         end
414 
415         R_INJECT_AW : begin
416           // Save beat
417           // During this cycle, w_req_q stores the original AW request
418           r_req_d.ar.id        = w_req_q.aw.id       ;
419           r_req_d.ar.addr      = w_req_q.aw.addr     ;
420           r_req_d.ar.size      = w_req_q.orig_aw_size;
421           r_req_d.ar.burst     = w_req_q.aw.burst    ;
422           r_req_d.ar.len       = w_req_q.burst_len   ;
423           r_req_d.ar.lock      = w_req_q.aw.lock     ;
424           r_req_d.ar.cache     = w_req_q.aw.cache    ;
425           r_req_d.ar.prot      = w_req_q.aw.prot     ;
426           r_req_d.ar.qos       = w_req_q.aw.qos      ;
427           r_req_d.ar.region    = w_req_q.aw.region   ;
428           r_req_d.ar.user      = w_req_q.aw.user     ;
429           r_req_d.ar_valid     = 1'b0                ; // Injected "AR"s from AW are not valid.
430           r_req_d.burst_len    = w_req_q.burst_len   ;
431           r_req_d.orig_ar_size = w_req_q.orig_aw_size;
432 
433           // Default state
434           r_state_d = R_PASSTHROUGH;
435 
436           case (r_req_d.ar.burst)
437             axi_pkg::BURST_INCR: begin
438               // Modifiable transaction
439               if (modifiable(r_req_d.ar.cache)) begin
440                 // No need to upsize single-beat transactions.
441                 if (r_req_d.ar.len != '0) begin
442                   // Evaluate output burst length
443                   automatic addr_t start_addr = aligned_addr(r_req_d.ar.addr, AxiMstPortMaxSize);
444                   automatic addr_t end_addr   = aligned_addr(beat_addr(r_req_d.ar.addr,
445                       r_req_d.orig_ar_size, r_req_d.burst_len, r_req_d.ar.burst,
446                       r_req_d.burst_len), AxiMstPortMaxSize);
447                   r_req_d.ar.len  = (end_addr - start_addr) >> AxiMstPortMaxSize;
448                   r_req_d.ar.size = AxiMstPortMaxSize                           ;
449                   r_state_d       = R_INCR_UPSIZE                               ;
450                 end
451               end
452             end
453 
454             axi_pkg::BURST_FIXED: begin
455               // Passes through the upsizer without any changes
456               r_state_d = R_PASSTHROUGH;
457             end
458 
459             axi_pkg::BURST_WRAP: begin
460               // The DW converter does not support this kind of burst ...
461               r_state_d              = R_PASSTHROUGH;
462               r_req_d.ar_throw_error = 1'b1         ;
463 
464               // ... but might if this is a single-beat transaction
465               if (r_req_d.ar.len == '0)
466                 r_req_d.ar_throw_error = 1'b0;
467             end
468           endcase
469         end
470 
471         R_PASSTHROUGH, R_INCR_UPSIZE: begin
472           // Request was accepted
473           if (!r_req_q.ar_valid)
474             if (mst_resp.r_valid && (idx_r_upsizer == t) && r_upsizer_valid) begin
475               automatic addr_t mst_port_offset = AxiMstPortStrbWidth == 1 ? '0 : r_req_q.ar.addr[idx_width(AxiMstPortStrbWidth)-1:0];
476               automatic addr_t slv_port_offset = AxiSlvPortStrbWidth == 1 ? '0 : r_req_q.ar.addr[idx_width(AxiSlvPortStrbWidth)-1:0];
477 
478               automatic slv_data_t r_data = slv_r_tran[t].data;
479 
480               // Valid output
481               slv_r_valid_tran[t] = 1'b1                                       ;
482               slv_r_tran[t].last  = mst_resp.r.last && (r_req_q.burst_len == 0);
483 
484               // Lane steering
485               for (int b = 0; b < AxiMstPortStrbWidth; b++) begin
486                 if ((b >= mst_port_offset) &&
487                     (b - mst_port_offset < (1 << r_req_q.orig_ar_size)) &&
488                     (b + slv_port_offset - mst_port_offset < AxiSlvPortStrbWidth)) begin
489                   r_data[b + slv_port_offset - mst_port_offset] = mst_resp.r.data[8*b +: 8];
